name: interp1
expr: r1 = interp1(x,y,1.5); r2 = interp1(x,y,2.5); r3 = interp1(x,y,1); pn = interp1(x,y,1.5,'next'); pp = interp1(x,y,1.5,'previous'); pk = interp1(x,y,2,'next'); oob = interp1(x,y,3.5,'previous');
comment: Sig r=interp1(x,y,xq[,method]). linear (default), nearest, spline, pchip, makima, and 'previous'/'next' step interpolation. 'next' = value at smallest knot >= xq; 'previous' = largest knot <= xq; queries outside [x(1),x(end)] -> NaN. interp1([1 2 3],[10 20 30],1.5,'next')=20, 'previous'=10; @knot both=knot value; 3.5 'previous'=NaN. numkit previously errored 'unknown method' on next/previous -- added. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
